members.label: Text Prompt
members.description: User-supplied text prompt. Connect to AI nodes' prompt input.

members.label: Upload Image
members.description: Upload an image asset. Output is the image URL.

members.label: Upload Video
members.description: Upload a video asset.

members.label: Upload Audio
members.description: Upload an audio asset.

members.label: Video URL
members.description: Download video or audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or X.

members.label: Reference Audio
members.description: Extract audio from YouTube videos or provide audio via upload/URL.

members.label: RSS Feed
members.description: Pull content from RSS/Atom feeds for automated content pipelines.

members.label: Web Scrape
members.description: Fetch data from web pages, Google Search, Instagram, TikTok, or RSS feeds and emit structured JSON.

members.label: Site Capture
members.description: Capture a web page the way a phone shows it: up to 8 section stills in page order on `image` (an Each wire runs once per still), and on `json` the full-page image, the section map and the page's exact figures. The page comes from `url`, or from the text wired into `in`. Available where capture is enabled on the install.

members.label: Meta Ads
members.description: Pull public Facebook and Instagram ads from Meta's Ad Library by keyword, advertiser or Facebook Page and emit structured JSON (copy, CTA, images, videos).

members.label: Instagram
members.description: Pull public Instagram posts (images, carousels, reels) by profile, by hashtag or by post link and emit structured JSON (caption, media, likes, comments).

members.label: Social Search
members.description: Search TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit, LinkedIn or Meta's Ad Library by keyword or account and get up to 60 posts with their numbers. Pick the ones to keep in the editor; a workflow run without picks passes on the first few.

members.label: Video Analysis
members.description: Scene-segmented analysis of a video: prompt-ready visuals, camera language, mode-tagged audio, castable entity slots.

members.label: AI Audit
members.description: Re-watches a clip against a wired analysis (or auto-runs a fast analysis first when none is wired), applies video-verified corrections under guards, and returns a disclosed report of what was checked, fixed, and left open.

members.label: Edit Plan
members.description: Turn a transcript into an edit-decision-list plan: tighten a recording, find short clips, mark chapters, or cut a short trailer. Reads the transcript, never pixels; emits an EDL that Apply Edit renders.

members.label: Camera Switch
members.description: Choose which camera shows each cut of an edit by who is speaking. Wire an Edit Plan's EDL and a diarized transcript; emits the switched EDL for Apply Edit and the transcript with your speaker names.

members.label: Generate Image
members.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using an AI provider.

members.label: Image to Video
members.description: Animate a still image into a video.

members.label: Text to Video
members.description: Generate video from a text prompt.

members.label: Generate Video
members.description: Unified video generation node — dispatches dynamically to image-to-video when a start frame is wired, otherwise text-to-video. One node, both modes, full VIDEO_GEN_PROVIDERS catalog.

members.label: Generate Video Pro
members.description: Long-form video generation on any model that accepts reference images (Seedance 2 family, MiniMax H3, VEO 3.1 family, Gemini Omni, Kling 3 Omni, Grok, HappyHorse). Requests above the model's single-segment cap are auto-split into multiple segments and stitched into one clip. Cloud edition only.

members.label: Edit Video Pro
members.description: Replace a span of an existing video with newly generated content — Seedance-2-family reference bridge, seamlessly stitched back into the source. Cloud edition only.

members.label: UGC Creator
members.description: The person who presents a UGC video: an AI creator, or your own photo (adults only); each new draw is a different person. In the editor it draws options for you to pick from.

members.label: UGC Script
members.description: Writes a UGC video's script from up to 8 screenshots and the product name or website (the opening line, the beats and the closing line), checks it against the video rules and rewrites it when it breaks one, three tries in all.

members.label: UGC Clips
members.description: Splits a UGC script into clips, one per take; its Clips output is a list, so UGC Clip runs once per clip. After a run of the node itself it shows what the clips will cost.

members.label: UGC Clip
members.description: Renders one clip of a UGC video and checks two of its frames, rendering once more if the check fails and keeping that take if it passes, else the first.

members.label: UGC Cards
members.description: Times a UGC video's screenshot cards and captions from the spoken words, checks that each clip said its line, and writes the Notes.

members.label: UGC Finish
members.description: Takes every clip of a UGC video at once and hands them on in order, ready to join. On a video cut from one recorded speech, it lays that speech back over each clip and trims the pauses between words.

members.label: Video SFX
members.description: Generate synchronized SFX / foley / ambient audio for a video clip using Replicate's mmaudio. Credit cost scales with input clip duration — one bucketed row per clip length (`replicate-mmaudio:<bucket>s`), spanning the advertised band pre-markup.

members.label: Video Depth
members.description: Turn a video into a depth video (near is bright, far is dark) with Video Depth Anything or Depth Anything per frame. Grayscale or a colormap. Credits scale with the input clip's length, in 15 s to 5 min tiers.

members.label: Reference Sheet
members.description: Composite a reference sheet (turnaround / expression board / variation board / detail) from a connected character, object, or location. Compose-only — uses panels the entity already has; emits the sheet image plus a clean panel set for downstream multi-image consistency.

members.label: Reference Board
members.description: Generate a dense reference board (hero + metadata + panels + 6-HEX palette) in one AI pass from reference image(s); refine globally, with a mask, or re-roll. Output is one cohesive board image for downstream consistency.

members.label: Text to Speech
members.description: Synthesize speech from text using ElevenLabs. Where length pricing is on, priced per started 100 characters of the text sent, at least 8 units (32 credits on v4, v3 and Multilingual v2; 16 on Turbo v2.5); otherwise the flat per-request row.

members.label: Generate Music
members.description: Generate music from a text prompt with MiniMax.

members.label: Suno Voice Persona
members.description: Create a custom Suno voice persona from a short recording. Configured once via a setup modal that runs the 2-step KIE voice/validate + voice/generate flow; emits a voiceId for use as personaId in suno-generate / suno-cover / suno-extend.

members.label: Text to Audio
members.description: Generate sound effects and ambient audio from a text description using ElevenLabs SFX. Priced per second of audio requested (rounded up; no duration is billed as 5 s).

members.label: Text to Dialogue
members.description: Generate multi-speaker dialogue audio where each line is spoken by a different voice (ElevenLabs Dialogue v3 by default or Dialogue v4 via `provider`, direct API — any voice: premade, library, or cloned). `stability` is 0–1: v3 takes exactly 0, 0.5 or 1, v4 any value; `similarityBoost` (0–1) is v4 only. Priced under the chosen model's identifier: where length pricing is on, per started 100 characters of the script, at least 8 units (32 credits on either dialogue model); otherwise flat per request. Its `json` output carries the timings (one segment per line, per-word timings) on both models.

members.label: Audio Isolation
members.description: Isolate and clean up vocal audio by removing background noise and non-speech elements.

members.label: Audio Separation
members.description: Separate ANY audio into vocals + instrumental, or full stems (drums, bass, other, guitar, piano), using Demucs on Replicate. Unlike Suno Separate, works on uploaded or upstream audio with no Suno track required.

members.label: Voice Changer
members.description: Replace the voice in an audio recording — or in an entire talking video — with a different voice, preserving the original emotion, cadence, and timing. Audio in → audio out; video in → revoiced video out (plus the new audio track). Video wins when both inputs are wired.

members.label: Voice Changer Pro
members.description: Detect each speaker in a multi-speaker recording and replace each one's voice independently, preserving words, timing and lip-sync. Provide an ordered list of target voices — voice N recasts the N-th speaker to talk; a null entry is a keep-slot (that speaker keeps their original voice). Per-voice engine: "sts" (default recast), "v3" (Re-speak — regenerates the performance from the transcript with eleven_v3) or "v4" (Re-speak with eleven_v4 — any stability 0–1, similarity honoured, each line generated with its neighbours as context). Cloud edition only.

members.label: Dubbing
members.description: Translate spoken audio OR video into another language while preserving each speaker's voice. Video in (or a public source link) delivers the dubbed VIDEO plus the dubbed audio track; priced per minute of the dubbed span (max 30 minutes — use the start/end window for longer sources).

members.label: Voice Remix
members.description: Generate a voice from a natural language description and hear it speak preview text.

members.label: Voice Design
members.description: Create a custom voice with full parameter controls and receive both an audio preview and a reusable voice ID.

members.label: Suno Create Music
members.description: Full song generation using Suno AI with extensive creative controls.

members.label: Suno Cover
members.description: Create a cover version of an existing audio track using Suno AI.

members.label: Suno Extend
members.description: Extend an existing Suno-generated track by continuing from a specified timestamp.

members.label: Suno Separate Stems
members.description: Separate vocals from instrumentals, or split a track into individual stems.

members.label: Suno Mashup
members.description: Blend two audio tracks into a single mashup using Suno AI.

members.label: Suno Replace Section
members.description: Replace a specific time range within a Suno-generated track with new content.

members.label: Suno Add Instrumental
members.description: Add an AI-generated instrumental backing track to an existing vocal track.

members.label: Suno Add Vocals
members.description: Add AI-generated vocals to an existing instrumental track.

members.label: Suno Convert WAV
members.description: Convert a Suno-generated MP3 audio track to lossless WAV format.

members.label: Suno Upload & Extend
members.description: Extend any audio file (not limited to Suno-generated tracks) using Suno AI.

members.label: Suno Lyrics
members.description: Generate song lyrics from a text prompt using Suno AI.

members.label: Suno Style Boost
members.description: Enhance and refine the style of lyrics or text content using Suno AI.

members.label: Generate Text - Any LLM
members.description: LLM text generation from a prompt (+ optional image/video/audio refs). Stream-capable. Two outputs: full text and a fan-out item list split on ===NEXT===.

members.label: Generate Script
members.description: AI-powered multi-scene script generation with cinematography details, character actions, and structured scene breakdowns.

members.label: Content Recipe
members.description: Why a post worked, as a reusable recipe: the hook (what is said, written and seen in the first 3 seconds), a format label with confidence, timed beats, why it works, CTA, sound and pace. Reads a Video Analysis, a scraped post or text; wire the Video URL node into Source post to cite the link.

members.label: Content Ideas
members.description: Turn one or more Content Recipes plus a brand profile into concrete post ideas — hook, format, beats, shot list, why it fits the brand, and the post that inspired it. Borrows structure, never the original's words, footage, music or faces. Emits a list: the next node runs once per idea.

members.label: Describe Image
members.description: Extract a text description from an image using Claude Sonnet vision, with configurable detail levels.

members.label: Describe to Picker
members.description: Analyze an image with a vision LLM and emit catalog-valid picker JSON (Person) to auto-fill a parameter picker.

members.label: Transcribe
members.description: Convert spoken audio to text (plain transcript on `text`, a normalized Transcript with word/segment timings on `json`), with optional speaker diarization and audio event tagging. Three engines: `elevenlabs-stt` (Scribe — always word-level, the only lane that diarizes or tags audio events), `incredibly-fast-whisper` (word timings on request) and `whisper` (no word timings at all).

members.label: QA Check
members.description: LLM quality gate — scores upstream text 0.0-1.0 against a check type (content / quality / consistency / safety) and returns score + approved + reason. Flat 1cr across LLM tiers (qa-check / :economy / :premium all = 1).

members.label: Forced Alignment
members.description: Generate word-level timestamps by aligning a transcript to its corresponding audio.

members.label: Face Swap
members.description: Replace the face in a video with a face from a reference image.

members.label: Retake Video
members.description: Replace a portion of an existing video — audio only, video only, or both — using Lightricks LTX 2.3 Pro's `retake` task. Billed per second of replaced material.

members.label: Video to Video
members.description: Transform existing video using AI with a text prompt.

members.label: Relight & Switch
members.description: Relight a video and switch/composite elements, driven by the original pixels: source video + alpha mask (auto/fill/select/custom) + reference image and/or prompt. Powered by Beeble SwitchX.

members.label: Lip Sync
members.description: Sync audio to a character's face to create a talking head video.

members.label: Speech to Video
members.description: Generate video driven by speech audio input using Wan 2.2.

members.label: AI Avatar
members.description: Generate a talking-avatar video from a HeyGen avatar + voice + script, or wired audio.

members.label: Cinematic Avatar
members.description: Generate a cinematic, prompt-driven avatar clip from 1-3 HeyGen avatar looks (generative Seedance pipeline). No script/voice — the prompt IS the direction.

members.label: Motion Transfer
members.description: Apply motion from a reference video to a static character image.

members.label: Upscale Video
members.description: Upscale video resolution using Topaz or VEO AI, or finalize a Seedance 2.5 draft at 1080p (same take).

members.label: Extend Video
members.description: Continue a generated video with a new prompt direction.

members.label: Suno Music Video
members.description: Generate a music video for a Suno-generated track.

members.label: Video Mask
members.description: Track a subject described in plain text through a video and output a black-and-white mask video (white = the subject), using SAM 3.1 (default) or SAM 3 (half the price). Credit cost scales with the clip's length at 30 fps — one row per model and length (`sam-3.1-video:<bucket>s` / `sam-3-video:<bucket>s`, up to 300 s; long clips are segmented in 60-second chunks). Pair it with Mask Composite to put the subject over another video.

members.label: Generate Mask
members.description: Produce a binary segmentation mask for a subject described by a text prompt (Grounded SAM).

members.label: Paint Mask
members.description: Hand-paint a mask over a connected image in the editor; emits the painted mask PNG (white = edit, black = preserve) for any mask input. Source node — never executes; optionally seeded by a Generate Mask output for hand-refinement.

members.label: Modify Image
members.description: Transform an existing image with a text prompt across 20+ image-to-image / editing providers (Flux, GPT Image, Ideogram, Nano Banana, Qwen, Seedream, + Nano Banana Edit). Migrated successor of edit-image.

members.label: Upscale Image
members.description: Increase image resolution with Recraft Upscale or Topaz Upscale (1x / 2x / 4x factor). No prompt — pure enhancement utility.

members.label: Remove Background
members.description: Remove the background from an image and output a transparent PNG (Recraft).

members.label: Image Critic
members.description: Score an image on realism / character consistency / prompt adherence / anatomy / aesthetic / style match via VLM. Two output handles (approved/rejected) for self-correction loops.

members.label: Combine Videos
members.description: Concatenate multiple videos with transitions, audio handling, boundary trims, and smart cut. Clips are conformed to their most common source frame rate (a tie goes to the higher); where smart cut finds a match it replaces the fixed boundary trims at that boundary.

members.label: Apply EDL
members.description: Render an edit decision list (EDL) into ONE media file (video OR audio, per `output`). The EDL's segment order is the output timeline; each segment names a source time-window on the master clock. Hard-cut boundaries abut, crossfade boundaries overlap (the rendered length is the overlap-compressed duration). When a transcript is wired, it is remapped through the cut on the `json` output handle so downstream captions stay aligned. Media resolves from each EdlSource.url; `sources` positionally overrides those URLs. Priced per minute of rendered output. Local ffmpeg, keyless.

members.label: Tighten Episode
members.description: Tighten a podcast recording in one step: transcribes it, removes silences and filler, cuts the episode, and optionally adds captions and a music bed. Video or audio. Its steps are priced at their own rates, plus a per-run fee (listed at 10 credits).

members.label: Speaker View
members.description: Render an edit with its speakers on screen: a layout (single, side by side, stacked, grid, picture-in-picture, or Camera Switch's hints), a switch at each speaker change (cut, pan, zoom, crossfade) and an emphasis on who is speaking (scale, border, dim). Wire an EDL (Edit Plan's or Camera Switch's) and a diarized transcript, or a plain video into `video` (instead of the EDL, never both) with the diarized transcript required; the clip is cut whole at the speakers' turns and defaults to 9:16, priced at the clip's measured length. Emits the video, the EDL as drawn on `json`, and the transcript remapped through that edit on `transcript` (what Add Captions reads). Wire Speaker Frames' face tracks into `tracks` and each speaker's crop follows their face (`motion`: glide, or static per segment). Priced per minute of rendered output: up to two speakers on screen at once and no zoom is the standard rate, three to six or any zoom the complex rate; a preview (`quality: proxy`) costs less than a final.

members.label: Speaker Frames
members.description: Find where each speaker's face is, over time, on every camera of an edit. Wire an EDL (Edit Plan's or Camera Switch's; a clip pack runs once over all its clips) or a single video, and the same renamed transcript Camera Switch outputs; it samples only the footage the edit keeps (plus 2 s each side) at 2 frames per second, on the cameras you leave ticked. Emits the face tracks as a stored file's descriptor on `tracks`. Priced per started block of 1,000 sampled frames, at least one block per run: reserved from the frames the server counts when the run starts (the edit's spans on the ticked cameras, or a bare video's measured length) and charged on the frames actually sampled. Tracks follow each face but aren't named after a speaker yet — Speaker View uses your drawn regions, or asks which face is whom.

members.label: Assemble Narrated Video
members.description: Fit N ordered (clip, voice) blocks into one MP4: center short voice, slow-to-fit long voice, never crop audio.

members.label: Image Collage
members.description: Composite N images into one 2K/4K image with a smart (justified) or grid layout. No image is cropped — smart floats the output height; grid letterboxes. Per-image size hints via imageSizes (0 auto / 1 big / 2 medium / 3 small, index-aligned with imageUrls; relative, smart layout only). Storyboard badges: set numbered to stamp 1-based sequence numbers, and imageLabels for per-image captions, at each image's top-left corner — or top-right via badgePosition (rendered as "3 · Close-up"). Local ffmpeg — priced by resolution (see the credit cost band; 4K is the dearer tier).

members.label: Image Overlay
members.description: Place up to 12 layers — wired pictures (logo, badge, cut-out), real text from bundled fonts (kind text), QR codes (kind qr) and flat shapes (kind shape) — on a base image, pixel-exactly. Each layer has an anchor (9 positions), x/y offset and width in PERCENT of the base image (so the same node works on a 1K preview and a 4K render), optional explicit height, opacity, rotation (any angle), blend mode (over / multiply / screen), fit, drop shadow and rounded corners. SVG logos are rasterised at the target size (crisp). Output keeps the base image's pixel size unless an output canvas is set. Local sharp — no AI, deterministic. Base image ← the image handle; layers ← overlay, overlay2 … overlay12 (index-aligned with layers[]; zIndex reorders the stack); a QR layer with qr.fromInput takes its link from the qrText text handle (a Text node, a List column — one QR per row in a batch). Outputs: image (the composite), mask, and one variant:<platformId> handle per platform in variants[] (e.g. variant:x-header, variant:youtube-thumbnail) so each platform render feeds its own publisher in the same run. Price: 10 credits + 2 per platform in variants[].

members.label: Video Overlay
members.description: Place up to 20 timed image layers — logos, product shots, screenshots, cards — over a video in one local FFmpeg pass; the base audio is kept untouched. Each layer has start / end seconds (no end = to the end of the video) and a placement: a preset (card · corner-badge with a corner · full-frame) or a box in PERCENT of the output frame (anchor, x, y, width, optional height, fit contain / cover), plus opacity, animate (0.15 s fade and slight scale) and zIndex. An explicit box field overrides the preset; a layer with neither is a corner badge (bottom-right, or the corner it names). Base video ← the video handle; layer images ← overlay, overlay2 … overlay12 (index-aligned with layers[]; layers 13 and up carry an imageUrl). Optional outputAspect (16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:5) with baseFit and backgroundColor; without it the output keeps the video's own size and frame rate. Layers past the end are clipped or skipped and an animated image renders its first frame — both reported in the output's warnings[]. Price: 20 credits per run.

members.label: Merge Video + Audio
members.description: Mux a video and an audio track.

members.label: Still to Video
members.description: Turn one still image + one audio track into an MP4 with an optional motion effect (zoom / pan / Ken Burns). Local FFmpeg — no provider, no GPU, zero credits. The output duration is the audio's duration (no duration field).

members.label: Slideshow
members.description: Turn 2-100 images + one optional audio track into an MP4 slideshow with per-slide motion (zoom / ken-burns / alternate) and transitions. Local FFmpeg — no provider, no GPU, zero credits. Audio wired: the output duration IS the audio's duration (never cropped); unwired: N x perImageDuration, silent output. Per-image duration overrides supported via imageDurations (null = auto).

members.label: Trim Video
members.description: Trim a video by start/end seconds.

members.label: Resize Video
members.description: Resize a video.

members.label: Extract Frame
members.description: Extract a single frame as an image.

members.label: Add Captions
members.description: Burn captions into a video. A plain static subtitle is a cheap FFmpeg drawtext burn; a kinetic style (word-highlight, karaoke, tiktok-words, word-pop, bouncy) — or a subtitle that is styled, per-segment, or timed from a transcript / auto-transcription — renders via Remotion and bills at the higher end of the range.

members.label: Adjust Speed
members.description: Change playback speed (0.05x to 100x), reverse, choose audio treatment (pitch-preserve / pitch-shift / drop), opt into motion-compensated frame interpolation (smooth slow-mo), or define a piecewise speed ramp via segments. FFmpeg only.

members.label: Split into Chunks
members.description: Cut a video or audio file into frame-exact parts, each between minPartDuration (default 4 s) and chunkDuration seconds — video parts on the video output, audio parts on the audio output (at most 200 per file). A wire with outputMode "each" runs the next node once per part; a wire with no mode passes the part outputChunkIndex names.

members.label: Gif to Video
members.description: Convert an animated GIF into a widely-compatible H.264 MP4 so it can be used as a motion reference for video models that reject GIF input. Optional loop-to-minimum, seam-aware looping (ping-pong for non-seamless GIFs), and 24fps interpolation. Local FFmpeg — no provider, zero credits.

members.label: Loop Video
members.description: Repeat video to reach a target duration or count, with optional smart-loop-cut for seamless seams.

members.label: Mask Composite
members.description: Put a foreground video over a background video through a mask video (white = foreground) — e.g. the subject from Video Mask over a new scene. Feather, grow/shrink and invert the mask; fit the background; pick the audio. Local FFmpeg — no provider. Priced per started 5 s of the result (one `mask-composite` row each, up to 300 s).

members.label: Fade Video
members.description: Add fade transitions to the beginning and end of video.

members.label: Transcode Video
members.description: Convert video codec, quality, and resolution.

members.label: Social Media Format
members.description: Auto-format video for specific platform specifications.

members.label: Manual Edit
members.description: Open video in a browser-based web editor for manual adjustments.

members.label: Remove Audio
members.description: Strip the audio track from a video, leaving a silent clip (stream-copied, lossless).

members.label: Trim Audio
members.description: Extract a section of audio or extract audio from video.

members.label: Mix Audio
members.description: Blend multiple audio tracks with individual volume control.

members.label: Combine Audio
members.description: Concatenate audio tracks end-to-end in order, with optional per-segment trim. (Mix Audio layers tracks; this joins them sequentially.)

members.label: Extract Audio
members.description: Demux the audio track from a video to a standalone MP3.

members.label: Silence Detect
members.description: Detect silent spans in an audio or video track (local FFmpeg silencedetect) and emit them as source-clock ranges.

members.label: Audio Sync
members.description: Measure how far apart the clocks of 2-6 recordings of one conversation are (camera files and/or a master mic), by cross-correlating their audio, so a multicam edit lines up without typed offsets. Wire the recordings (audio or video) into `sources`; `reference` picks the source every offset is measured against (default: the first). Emits { version, reference, offsets: [{ sourceId, offsetMs, confidence, driftMsPerHour }], notes } with referenceMs = sourceMs + offsetMs; drift is measured and warned, never corrected. Priced per source aligned to the reference. Local ffmpeg, keyless.

members.label: Adjust Volume
members.description: Change audio volume with optional normalize and fade-in / fade-out transitions (FFmpeg). (creditCost auto-filled from STATIC_CREDIT_COSTS = 1)

members.label: Audio FX
members.description: Apply creative audio effects (FFmpeg) — scenario reverbs (Room, Bathroom, Car, Hall, Concert Hall, Church, Cave, Arena, Outdoor), Telephone, Megaphone, Echo, or Custom (delay + EQ). Places a dry voice into a believable space before mixing onto video.

members.label: Pitch & Tempo
members.description: Shift pitch by semitones (−12…+12) and change tempo without changing pitch (0.5×–2×), with optional formant preservation — FFmpeg's Rubber Band filter. Audio in → audio out; video in → video out with the picture untouched (tempo is fixed at 1× for video). Priced per started minute of the input, up to 30 minutes.

members.label: Render Video
members.description: Render a Remotion composition to MP4. A 3D scene plan is priced by frame size: the flat price up to 1920 px on the longest side, 1.5x above that, 2.5x for a large square frame.

members.label: After Effects
members.description: AI-generated post-processing layer.

members.label: Motion Graphics
members.description: AI-generated 2D motion graphics (classic elements or AI-authored Lottie).

members.label: Generate 3D Scene
members.description: Generate an editable animated 3D clay scene from a prompt and optional image/video references. Video reference analysis is charged separately.

members.label: Edit 3D Scene
members.description: Create a new 3D scene revision from an instruction or deterministic edits; preserve locked objects. Deterministic edits are free; optional video reference analysis is charged separately.

members.label: 3D Render Pro
members.description: ONE durable operation producing both a 3D scene composition and its rendered MP4. `source` is exactly one of: {kind:'prompt'} to author a new scene from a brief plus optional references; {kind:'scene', revisionId, sourceJobId} to use an existing revision — with no editPrompt this is a render-only export that costs no authoring, with one it revises the scene first; or {kind:'local-export'} where a paired desktop Blender is available. Quote it first at POST /v1/pro-3d-render/quote and submit the returned quoteId. The result carries the MP4, the scene revision, and `shotStills` — one still per shot of the composition, ordered by shotIndex — on the `stills` output handle.

members.label: 3D Title
members.description: AI-generated 3D animated text.

members.label: Video Composer
members.description: AI-powered scene-graph video composition from natural language prompts.

members.label: Lottie Overlay
members.description: AI-placed timed Lottie animations overlaid on video.

members.label: Composite
members.description: Multi-layer video compositor (up to 4 layers) with per-layer positioning, scale, blending, and opacity. Client-side plan, no AI — deterministic and free.

members.label: Webhook Trigger
members.description: Trigger the workflow via HTTP POST.

members.label: Schedule Trigger
members.description: Run the workflow on a schedule: a list of rules (every N minutes / hours / days / weeks / months, or a cron expression) read in a timezone. Fires only while `active` is true — a new schedule starts paused. A wired trigger runs only the branch behind it.

members.label: Telegram Account Trigger
members.description: Trigger the workflow when a message arrives in a chosen chat of a Telegram account you connected (Integrations → Telegram account; Cloud, preview). Listens only while switched on with an account and at least one chat. Emits the message text (`out`) and the post it points at: `videoLink` (a post with a video to analyze), `postText` (a post's words when it has no video) and `postLink`; chatId, messageId, senderId and chatType ride along. Inbox mode: only the owner's own shares start a run, one run per post link (up to 3) or one per forwarded post. Free — downstream nodes incur their own costs.

members.label: Telegram Trigger
members.description: Trigger the workflow when a connected Telegram bot receives a message. Emits text + chatId + messageId + messageType (+ imageUrl/videoUrl/audioUrl for media). Free — downstream nodes incur their own costs.

members.label: Save to Storage
members.description: Persist a node output to user storage.

members.label: Webhook Output
members.description: POST a node output to a URL.

members.label: Instagram Post
members.description: Publish images, reels, stories, and carousels directly to Instagram.

members.label: TikTok Post
members.description: Publish video content directly to TikTok.

members.label: YouTube Upload
members.description: Upload videos and Shorts to YouTube with full metadata control.

members.label: LinkedIn Post
members.description: Post text, images, and video to LinkedIn.

members.label: X Post
members.description: Post text, images, and video to X (Twitter).

members.label: Facebook Post
members.description: Post text, images, video, and stories to Facebook.

members.label: Telegram Post
members.description: Send a message, photo, or video to a Telegram chat, channel, or group via a connected bot (send type auto-detected from connected media).

members.label: Publish to Social
members.description: Publish to any connected social account (Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, Bluesky, Reddit, and more) — pick the account and the platform follows.

members.label: Telegram Reply
members.description: Send the text wired in back to yourself on Telegram (Cloud, preview): as your connected account — under the post that started the run (Telegram Account Trigger runs), or to your Saved Messages — or from your own connected bot, as a private message. Never to anyone else. Whatever is wired in arrives as one message per run (up to 3 parts). 10 credits per message.

members.label: Telegram Channel Feed
members.description: Read recent posts from a PUBLIC Telegram channel (t.me/s/<channel>) — emits their text for rewrite/repost workflows. Pair with a Schedule Trigger to poll; dedupes via a per-node cursor so each post is processed once.

members.label: Read Collection
members.description: Read a collection's records saved in the last N hours or days — newest or oldest first, up to a limit — as structured records (json), one item per record for an each-wire, and as text (headlines, or the full text). A window with nothing in it emits empty text, so a text node behind it is skipped and the run ends nothing-new. Free.

members.label: Read Inspiration
members.description: Read the posts saved to your Inspiration library in the last N hours or days, or on one day — optionally one platform (X, Instagram, TikTok, …) and one tag — as posts (json, the Social Search post shape, with when each was saved, its note and tags; one item per post for an each-wire) and as text (their digest). The still copied when the post was saved replaces the platform's expiring thumbnail. Nothing in the period emits empty text, so a text node behind it is skipped and the run ends nothing-new. Free.

members.label: Read Competitor
members.description: Read a tracked competitor's posts as its scans found them — published in the last N hours or days, or on one day; optionally one platform (X, Instagram, TikTok, …) and the brand's own posts or the posts about it — as posts (json, the Social Search post shape with a role; one item per post for an each-wire) and as text (their digest). It reads what the scans already found: a day no scan covered has no posts, and each scan reads up to 20 posts per account. Nodaro Cloud. Free.

members.label: Save to Collection
members.description: Save what is wired in as one record of a collection: the item (a feed post, a search result, an article object, or plain text) mapped to title / text / link / media / fields, with the node's own title, text, link and dedupe key winning; the picture and video wired in ride along as links. The same link twice is one record (duplicate); a re-run of the same step writes once (replayed); past the plan's cap the oldest records are evicted. Emits the saved record. Free.

members.label: List
members.description: Static list of items for fan-out.

members.label: Group
members.description: Visual container that groups child nodes via React Flow parentId — emits members as a structured list to downstream consumers (Loop, Merge Lists, sub-workflow).

members.label: Collect
members.description: Explicit list-builder — multiple inputs converge on a single 'in' handle in connection order and emit as a structured list downstream.

members.label: Teleport Send
members.description: Broadcast its upstream value on a named channel (A-F) without a visible wire — every Teleport Receive tuned to the same channel gets the value.

members.label: Teleport Receive
members.description: Receive a value from a Teleport Send node on the same channel (A-F), without a visible wire. Multiple receivers can listen on one channel.

members.label: Filter List
members.description: Keep only the upstream list items matching one or more field conditions (AND/OR), with 12 operators (equals, contains, regex, in-list, ...).

members.label: Sort List
members.description: Sort an upstream list by value or by a dot-path field, with Auto/Text/Number/Date comparison and asc/desc direction (missing values sort last).

members.label: Deduplicate
members.description: Remove duplicate items from an upstream list, keeping the first occurrence. Compares whole items or a dot-path field.

members.label: Merge Lists
members.description: Combine multiple upstream lists into one — concatenate (append in edge order) or zip (element-wise merge with modulo-wrap), with optional dedupe.

members.label: JSON Process
members.description: Transform upstream JSON — input-path drill, filter conditions, and field projection via a visual builder, or a raw transformation expression in Advanced mode.

members.label: Extract Field
members.description: Pull a specific field or dot-notation path from upstream JSON — output can be a single string, a list for fan-out, or a raw JSON value.

members.label: Router
members.description: Conditionally split workflow execution into one or more named routes (radio / checkbox / conditional modes). Passes the upstream value through to each active route.

members.label: Preview
members.description: Display any upstream result (text, image, video, or audio) inline on the canvas for inspection. Display-only sink — no downstream output.

members.label: Sticky Note
members.description: Place annotated notes on the workflow canvas for documentation and organization.

members.label: Selector
members.description: Pick item(s) from a list — supports item/range/list/random/modulo/predicate/named-key modes. Two outputs: picked + rest.

members.label: Combine Text
members.description: Concatenate text inputs.

members.label: Split Text
members.description: Split text by delimiter.

members.label: Sub-Workflow
members.description: Embed another workflow as a node. Selects a route (matched input+output pair) on the referenced workflow; ports become handles on the parent canvas. Expand opens the child for editing with a breadcrumb back to the parent.

members.label: Sub-Workflow Input
members.description: Entry boundary of a callable sub-workflow route. Declares per-port handles consumed by nodes inside the sub-workflow.

members.label: Sub-Workflow Output
members.description: Exit boundary of a callable sub-workflow route. Declares per-port handles collected from inner nodes and returned to the caller.

members.label: Component
members.description: Embed a published Nodaro Component (a curated, versioned sub-workflow from the marketplace or your own apps) as a black-box node — its exposed inputs/settings/outputs surface in the config panel.

members.label: Choose Best
members.description: Turns N candidate results into ONE: an AI judge picks the best against your criteria (pick-best-llm), or the candidates are joined (concat), the first non-empty is taken (first-non-empty), counted (count), voted (vote), or merged as JSON (merge-json). Credit cost varies per strategy via the `reduce:<strategyId>` composite key.

members.label: Character
members.description: Reusable character — portrait, expressions, poses, motion clips, voice & personality, edited in the full-screen Character Studio.

members.label: Face
members.description: Reusable face reference.

members.label: Object/Props
members.description: Reusable object / prop reference.

members.label: Animal/Creature
members.description: Reusable animal / creature reference — species, angles, poses, variations, motion clips, edited in the full-screen Creature Studio.

members.label: Location
members.description: Reusable location reference.

members.label: Story → Video
members.description: Conversational pipeline: prompt + duration + format → editable film graph. Runs in the pipeline orchestrator, not the workflow DAG.

members.label: Scene
members.description: Structured scene container with shot list, camera, motion. Pipeline-managed — populated by the Scene Director LLM and animated by the pipeline orchestrator (Phase 1C). Outputs: composite_video / last_frame / audio_track. Not directly user-editable in 1B.2; users approve/reject scenes via the pipeline panel.

members.label: Music Genre
members.description: Pick a music genre (single or up to 3 for fusion) with optional subgenre and era. Emits a prompt-hint for Suno/MiniMax/Text-to-Audio.

members.label: Music Mood
members.description: Pick energy + emotion + vibe for music generation.

members.label: Instrumentation
members.description: Pick instruments (up to 5) + production style + vocal presence (up to 3) + singing style (up to 3). 'instrumental' vocal-presence flips MiniMax instrumental flag.

members.label: Voice Character
members.description: Pick age + gender + language (up to 3 for multilingual) + accent + timbre for ElevenLabs Voice Design.

members.label: Voice Delivery
members.description: Pick pace + emotion + archetype for ElevenLabs Voice Design.

members.label: Provider
members.description: Choose a model (image or video) for the nodes it is wired into: its provider output sets the model of a Generate Image, Generate Video or Generate Video Pro node through that node's settings input.

members.label: Tone
members.description: Define a tone or style modifier text (e.g., "cinematic", "cheerful") to influence connected AI nodes.

members.label: Style Guide
members.description: Define visual style reference text for consistent aesthetics across AI generation nodes in a workflow.

members.label: Motion
members.description: Set how much a video moves: adds a subtle / moderate / dynamic clause to a Generate Video or Generate Video Pro prompt through that node's settings input.

members.label: Scene Count
members.description: Specify the number of scenes for script generation nodes.

members.label: Duration
members.description: Set a length in seconds: a Generate Script node's target length (its field-targetLength input) or a Generate Video / Generate Video Pro duration (their settings input).

members.label: Aspect Ratio
members.description: Set the aspect ratio of a Generate Image, Generate Video or Generate Video Pro node through its settings input.

members.label: Setting
members.description: Pick a setting from 63 entries across 4 categories (indoor, urban, nature, fantastical). Emits a setting-description prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Atmosphere
members.description: Pick an atmospheric condition from 40 entries (clear, fog, dust, rain, snow, smoke, ...). Emits an atmosphere prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Style
members.description: Pick a style preset from 48 entries (cinematic, anime, oil-painting, photoreal, ...). Emits a style-descriptor prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Color / Look
members.description: Pick a color-grading look from 41 entries (warm, teal-orange, bleached, vintage, ...). Emits a color-grading prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Mood
members.description: Pick a mood from 50 entries (calm, tense, melancholic, joyful, ominous, ...). Emits a mood/emotion prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Photographer / Artist
members.description: Pick from 67 photographers, artists, directors, illustrators, or painters (Tim Walker, Deakins, Lubezki, Ghibli, Rutkowski, ...). Emits a 'style of X' prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Aesthetic / Microtrend
members.description: Pick a microtrend aesthetic from 46 entries (y2k, cottagecore, vaporwave, dark-academia, ...). Emits an aesthetic-descriptor prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Era / Period
members.description: Pick a historical era from 32 entries (1950s, 1990s-mall, ancient-rome, victorian, ...). Emits a period prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Photo Genre
members.description: Pick a photography genre from 46 entries (fashion-editorial, street, macro, documentary, ...). Emits a genre/composition prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Backdrop
members.description: Pick a studio backdrop from 40 entries (white-seamless, cyc-wall, gradient, painted, ...). Emits a backdrop prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Render Quality
members.description: Pick a render-pipeline preset from 24 entries (raytracing, octane, unreal, blender, ...). Emits a render-quality prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Composition Effect
members.description: Pick a composition effect from 19 entries (none, bursting-through-frame, pixel-disintegration, ...). Emits a composition prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Post-Process Effect
members.description: Pick a post-processing effect from 18 entries (vignette-soft, film-grain, light-leak, chromatic-aberration, ...). Emits a post-process prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Action FX
members.description: Pick environmental effects (multi-pick) from the action-fx catalog (earthquake, lightning, explosion, falling-objects, ...). Emits a scene-event prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Loop Subject
members.description: Pick a loop subject from 35 entries across 2 categories. Emits a subject descriptor for seamlessly looped video content.

members.label: Camera Motion
members.description: Pick a camera motion from 71 entries across categories (static/pan/tilt/dolly/zoom/track). Graph-aware: walks startState/endState input handles. Emits a 'beginning with X, ending with Y' prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Lens
members.description: Pick a lens from 16 entries (wide-angle, normal-50mm, telephoto, fisheye, anamorphic, ...). Emits a lens-characteristic prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Camera / Film Stock
members.description: Pick a camera or film format from 31 entries (35mm-film, IMAX, super-8, polaroid, vhs, ...). Emits a camera-medium prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Transition
members.description: Pick a cinematic transition (76 entries, 8 categories) with position/duration/intensity timing fields. Multi-pick supported. Graph-aware startState/endState handles. Emits a transition prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Character FX
members.description: Pick character-driven effects (57 entries, 5 categories — transformation, power, body-mod, face FX, aura) with position/duration/intensity timing. Multi-pick supported. Target ref-name substitution via the `target` input handle. Emits a subject-bound prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Character Motion
members.description: Pick what the subject does across the clip (1054 moves, 20 categories — entrances, turns, head and hand gestures, walks, runway, dance, expressions, camera interaction, stylized combat, athletics, falls, posture, everyday actions, vehicles, animals, two-person moves, idle life, stage, uncanny). Up to 3 ordered picks joined with "then", with position/pace timing. `target` names the subject and `partner` a second person, animal or object recipient. Emits a subject-bound prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Pose
members.description: Pick a pose from 81 entries across categories (standing, sitting, action, dynamic). Emits a pose-descriptor prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Material
members.description: Pick a material from 66 entries (silk, leather, metal, glass, marble, ...). Emits a material-descriptor prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Animal
members.description: Pick an animal from 126 entries across subcategories (mammal, bird, reptile, sea, insect, etc.). Emits 'featuring a X' prompt fragment with description via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Vehicle
members.description: Pick a vehicle from 107 entries across subcategories (car, truck, motorcycle, boat, aircraft, spaceship, etc.). Emits 'featuring a X' prompt fragment with description via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Weapon
members.description: Pick a weapon from 85 entries across subcategories (blade, ranged, firearm, fantasy, sci-fi, etc.). Emits 'with a X' prompt fragment with description via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Held Prop
members.description: Pick a held prop from 59 entries (smartphone, umbrella, bouquet, briefcase, ...). Emits a held-prop prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Furniture
members.description: Pick a furniture piece from 78 entries across 9 categories (seating, tables, beds, storage, lighting, kitchen-dining, outdoor, decorative, bath). Emits an 'including a X' prompt fragment with description via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Framing
members.description: Multi-dim picker for shot-size + angle + coverage + composition + vantage (72 catalog options across 5 fields). Emits a framing-descriptor prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Lighting
members.description: Multi-dim picker for time-of-day + lighting-style + lighting-direction (72 catalog options across 3 fields). Emits a lighting-descriptor prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Person
members.description: Multi-dim picker for person attributes — type, age, ethnicity, build, body proportions, face shape, jawline, cheekbones, facial fullness, eyes (shape, eyelid type, canthal tilt, spacing, brow distance), nose, nose tip, lip fullness, lip shape, hair, eyebrows, skin, facial hair, distinctive features (~573 options across 29 fields, incl. a dedicated facial-geometry layer). Emits a detailed person-description prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Styling
members.description: Multi-dim picker for makeup + eyewear + headwear + hair cut/treatment + jewelry + nails + face-paint + fabric (262 catalog options across 9 fields). Emits a styling-descriptor prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Temporal
members.description: Multi-dim picker for temporal-speed + freeze + direction + shutter (18 catalog options across 4 fields). Emits a temporal-effect prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.

members.label: Exposure Settings
members.description: Multi-dim picker for aperture + shutter-speed + ISO (20 catalog options across 3 fields). Emits a camera-exposure prompt fragment via the cinematography handle.
